archetypes.name: dyn-fence-parser
archetypes.rationale: Stateful fence detection is the load-bearing parser behavior changed here.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the two-pass fence handling in the issue batch parser. Check that only balanced backtick or tilde fences suppress item-boundary and OOS-field parsing, that unclosed fences degrade to plain body text, and that fence closers are not reinterpreted as new openers that swallow later boundaries. Compare the regression fixtures against the intended body-file contents. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
